The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234 as soon as possible, and wants to check different options. They want to calculate the business class fare from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost for travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_from first airport, travel_to last airport, travel_class business. That returns cost in USD. Then we need to estimate total payable amount. But what about booking? The user wants to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234. We might need to book flight? But they want to check different options. They want to calculate cost. So we can just compute flight cost. But maybe we also need to get the current booking? Or maybe we need to cancel booking? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking ID 1234 as soon as possible". That implies we might need to cancel existing booking? Or maybe we need to book new flight? But they want to check different options. So maybe we just compute cost. The user didn't ask to actually book. They want to check options. So we can compute flight cost. Then provide estimated total payable amount. But we might need to consider insurance? Not mentioned. So just cost.

Thus we need to call get_all_airports to get list. Then get_flight_cost with travel_from first, travel_to last, travel_date 2024-10-31, travel_class business. Then output cost.

We need to call get_all_airports. Then get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
